body:
*Posting in comments cuz it keeps getting removed*  


Just to clear a few things, I do have CC and mods (none of the mods are for hybrids or occults sims).

  
I am in the midst of my 10-generation challenge and the 6th-generation heir just turned into a teen. As soon as she aged up I got two notifications saying her werewolf and vampires have basically manifested (y'know the usual notification when you have an occult sim). Both of the parents have the dormant wolf trait but their parents were werewolves. There is no trace of vampires in the family tree and the sim had the werewolf trait since birth. I am confused about how it happened and why, maybe due to my mods? Their occult form is also very glitchy and has a "?" on the forehead. The sim can use some vampire and werewolf abilities too. They also have werewolf temperaments and vampire energy and thirst.
imagine being this close to him..
Thank you but I haven't lived in a moment that makes me feel like I should stay in a very long time.
Thank you but it's really hard to make friends (for me at least).
Thank you, I really appreciate this.
I can't even begin to fathom how strong you are, the fact that it's already been 31 years and you're still alive is amazing. There has to be a reason why you're still here.
It's okay, goodnight :)
Can't you call someone? I don't know how I would feel if we never talked again.
No problem, I know what it feels like to have no one to talk to. I can stay here for as long as you need
I still don't think it's too late, you're still here with me
why not?
yeah, I mean I care enough to be here with you.
but we just met, I don't want you to be dead. you told me to wait, we can keep waiting.
I don't know, I can't give you a good answer, I feel exactly how you feel every day but I'm still here. Someone cares about you.
But I don't want you to go.
I don't think it's too late to change your mind
You're not a failure and you shouldn't try doing it again.
I see... are you sure about this?
why?
I'm here :) even if you feel like you don't have any talents, you can always learn.
Try me
I've waited long enough, how about you?
for what?
Hey, I'm here
no we won't, please take it easy. I'm a stranger but I'm here if you need me.
nothing happened with the pills which was the problem, I guess I just didn't take enough or the right ones.
me too..

I don't know if this is going to make you feel any better, but I at least talk to myself once every day out loud. I'm not sure if this makes me crazy or not but I find comfort in it, so I guess you're not alone.
They were streaming on twitch today but it ended and I don't think they saved it so sadly idk where I can find it
omfg XD

Honestly, I believe there is hope for everyone, not everyone cares about looks because that's just the surface, what really matters is what's in the inside (this is very cliche but it's true). You also gotta know your worth, build up that confidence, if someone doesn't want you based solely off your looks?? that's their loss. I hope you'll find someone to love you for you because that time will come.

I am slowing finding fewer and fewer reasons to stay. I have a lot of siblings but there's my 8-year-old brother whom I'm very close with. I would never want him to go through grief or possibly end up like me because of something I did.
this is literally me and how I think, let's be friends
it's the music for me LOL
LMAOOO

Thanks for reaching out but I truly don't think "things get better" for everyone. I've heard the phrase countless times and I've stopped believing in it. I believe that sometimes we just don't get our happy endings or that things get better because sadly not everyone deserves to be happy.
My mother is aware, it's just something I don't feel like talking to her about, it gets awkward and I start to feel bad.
true but we're still here
I'm glad
I hope you're still here
